title: Reliability Symphony — 90-day activation plan
content:
Communication plan:
- Weekly 30-min sync with Product, Platform, Observability on Tuesdays.
- Bi-weekly executive snapshot (Priya) with TOP-3 risks and metric trends.
- Internal playbook published to Confluence and linked in #sre and #platform channels.

Immediate next actions (first 10 days):
- [Evelyn] Finalize SLO template and circulate for review (due: day 4)
- [Maya] Stand up baseline dashboards for latency and errors for the top-6 routes (due: day 7)
- [Tom] Provide list of Dedicated pools and suggested low-risk shard for canary (due: day 7)
- [Rafael] Align on customer communication template for canary enrollments (due: day 10)

Appendix (notes / scratch):
- Quick sample SLO entries: "/v1/generate - availability 99.9% monthly, latency p95 < 350ms, error-rate < 0.1%"
- Example burn-rate recording PromQL: increase(error_count[1h]) / increase(allowed_error_budget[30d])  (placeholder)
- Jira backlog: SRE-427 (SLO catalog bootstrap), PLAT-812 (canary infra), SERVE-653 (dynamic batching A/B harness)

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally pragmatic; we should prioritize measurable wins and avoid large multi-quarter rewrites. Feedback: add missing owners, call out any blocked infra work, and flag any regulatory constraints for Private deployments.

End.
